PORT.description: HTTP listen port (must match EXPOSE and the domain port)

SERVER_PORT.description: Server port used by the startup proxy check. Must equal PORT.

INTELLIGENCE_API_URL.description: CopilotKit Intelligence platform API (durable threads, memory, history). Required.

INTELLIGENCE_API_KEY.description: CopilotKit Intelligence project runtime key (cpk-...). Get one at https://intelligence.copilotkit.ai (API Keys) or via the CopilotKit CLI. Required.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI (or OpenAI-compatible) API key used by the built-in bots. Replace with a real key. Required.

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Optional base URL for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (vLLM, Ollama, LiteLLM). Leave empty for api.openai.com.

TRUSTED_ORIGINS.description: Origin(s) the app is served from (comma-separated). Defaults to your Railway public domain.

OPENBOT_SINGLE_USER.description: Run as a single administrator with no sign-in screen (every visitor = admin). Set to false once you configure an SSO provider.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Session-cookie signing secret (32+ chars). Required when SSO sign-in is turned on.

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: Public API URL where OAuth callbacks land. Defaults to your Railway public domain.

INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated emails granted the admin role (required when OPENBOT_SINGLE_USER=false).

GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth client ID (configure to enable Google sign-in).

GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Google OAuth client secret (configure to enable Google sign-in).

MICROSOFT_OAUTH_TENANT_ID.description: Microsoft tenant ID; 'common' admits personal accounts too. Set your directory GUID for company-only.

MANAGED_AGENT_AG_UI_URL.description: Optional external AG-UI agent endpoint (LangGraph / Mastra / CrewAI harness). Requires MANAGED_AGENT_TOKEN.

MANAGED_AGENT_TOKEN.description: Bearer token presented by the external AG-UI harness when calling tools back.

AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS.description: How many days of audit trail to keep. Empty (default) keeps everything — the trail is append-only.
